description: Get one item of any kind by the id from search_library: an agent, prompt, mind, AI tool or mini tool (skills and workflows work too). Concise (default): what it does, inputs and outputs, how to use it, files or links, and for AI tools the price, limits and when we last checked. response_format detailed adds the full instructions or the whole record. Cite its url.

id.description: The id from a search_library row.

response_format.description: concise (default): a short view without the full instructions. detailed: everything, with the full SKILL.md text; use it only for an item you will run.

revision_sha256.description: Exact lowercase catalogue SHA-256 revision returned by discovery or retrieval.

type.description: The row's type. Needed only when two kinds share an id.

name: get_item
title: Get any item by id
